blocks.text: The Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Storage outegration is used as a report delivery method to dispatch files from the Zscaler Security Operations (SecOps) platform applications (e.g., UVM) to your Google Cloud Storage bucket.
This article is a step-by-step guide to configuring Google Cloud Storage as a storage outegration.
Before you configure the outegration, ensure the following requirements are met:

blocks.item: Service Account
Create a new service account or select an existing one dedicated to report delivery in the Google Cloud console. To learn more, refer to the Google Cloud documentation.
Service Account Permissions

To grant the service account the permission to write objects to a Google Cloud Storage bucket, you need to assign it the Storage Object Creator role and Storage Legacy Bucket Reader role for that specific bucket. To learn more, refer to the Google Cloud documentation.
If the service account requires write access across multiple buckets within a single project, assign the role at the project level.
JSON Keys
To generate a JSON key file, go to the Service Accounts page in the Google Cloud console. To learn more, refer to the Google Cloud documentation.
Google Cloud Storage Bucket Name

To retrieve the Google Cloud Storage's bucket name from the Google Cloud console, go to the Cloud Storage Buckets page and view the list of available buckets for your project. To learn more, refer to the Google Cloud documentation.
Google Cloud Storage Bucket's Project ID
To retrieve the Google Cloud Storage bucket's Project ID, use the Google Cloud console, the command line, or the Storage API. To learn more, refer to the Google Cloud documentation.

blocks.heading: Creating a Google Cloud Storage Outegration

blocks.text: To configure the Google Cloud Storage outegration:

blocks.item: In the SecOps platform, go to Configure > Outegrations.
See image.
Click Create and select GCP Storage.
In the Details section:
Display Name: Enter a name for your outegration.
Bucket: Enter the name of the Google Cloud Storage bucket where report files are to be delivered.
Project ID: Enter the unique identifier of the GCP project associated with the Google Cloud Storage bucket.
Path: (Optional) Enter the folder path to organize and separate the reports within the Google Cloud Storage bucket.
Authentication: Select an existing authentication ID, or click Create New to set up a new authentication, and enter parameters from the Prerequisites section.
See image.
See image.
Click Test in the bottom-right corner of the page to verify the connection. If the credentials are invalid, an error message is displayed along with the remediation steps to resolve the issue.
After the connection is verified, click Finish.

blocks.text: When the outegration setup is complete, you can begin using the GCP Storage outegration as a delivery method for your reports.

blocks.heading: Using Google Cloud Storage in Report Export

blocks.text: After you create a Google Cloud Storage outegration, the outegration name appears in each report's Delivery Method drop-down menu. To learn more, see Scheduling Reports to Export.
